clock: Synthetic calendar; IST UTC+05:30; not observed field dates
split_design: 20 independent parameter groups; 12 train, 4 validation, 4 sealed acceptance; 3 runs/group. Same simulator families across groups; no claim of independent field validation.
commissioning: 20 independent healthy 14-day traces, one per parameter group; separately identified; never infer healthy calibration from test trace starts.

thermal_equations.loss: P0 + Pk75 * mean((I_phase/I_rated)^2) + extra_loss; Pk75 held at reference, not iterated for winding resistance
thermal_equations.hotspot_latent: top_oil + max(phase winding-gradient first-order states); assumed 12-18 K rated gradient, 6-12 min time constant; no measured target hotspot
thermal_equations.terminal: ambient + I_R^2 * contact_resistance * thermal_resistance, first-order 12 min; exploratory LV terminal surface, not dielectric bushing fault

oil_level_equation: inventory=190-integral(leak_rate dt); expanded_volume=inventory*(1+beta*(oil-20)); level=0.5+(expanded_volume-190)/30; idealized 30 L effective conservator gauge; reference20C, geometry and beta are assumptions
explicit_exclusions: No fabricated DGA, BDV, furan, moisture lab series; no copied external paper values expanded to SCADA; no field failure probability or ML accuracy claim.
HI_refresh: 24 samples = 2 hours; retain sample-level quality and urgent event records separately. This package supplies window coverage, not new HI truth or app behaviour.
measurement_tolerance: Organiser 1% test applies to six supplied voltage/current fixtures only. Ordinary simulator noise and adversarial sensor errors are separately documented.
learning_contract: Only numeric measured core inputs in feature_allowlist.json by default. Join labels by key outside feature matrix. Exclude IDs, calendar timestamps, splits, source labels, oracle profiles, latent channels and post-event outcomes.
parent_reuse: All 60 operating histories and original whole-parameter-group partitions retained. Not a new untouched test set.
expansion: Oil temperature-adjusted estimates, 120 adversarial oil-control histories, explicit optional channels, external reference measurements and independent fast-event registry.
unsupported_channels: Unavailable with flag=0; no invented tank pressure, internal bushing fault, target vibration, measured hotspot or impedance test series.
external_join_policy: Never join other-rating external measurements or independent waveform benchmarks to target SCADA timestamps.

oil_feature_equations.inventory_estimate_L: expanded_volume/(1+0.000725*(observed_top_oil_C-20)); fixed provisional beta, not latent profile beta
oil_feature_equations.past_change: inventory(t)-inventory(t-23*5min); available only with 24 consecutive complete level/temperature samples; 115-minute endpoint spacing inside a 2-hour bucket

parameter_status: Oil geometry, expansion coefficient, refill and fault severities are explicit simulator assumptions; new internet files do not calibrate the target.
